memory_model.WORD: 16bit two-complement -32768..32767; hex16#0000..FFFF; unsigned exceptions includeSW andhardwarecounterobjects
memory_model.aliasing: %MDi and%MFi alias underlying%MWi(low16)+%MWi+1(high16); %KD/%KF likewise%KW. Odd start indices legal but overlap neighbors.
memory_model.indexed: base+signed%MWindex; %MW[%PARAM] only owningUDF/UDFB. Out-of-zone sets%S20 and index reverts0 (base object, not guaranteed memory address0). Allocation bound is highest directly referenced object; actual configured allocation must be respected.
memory_model.strings: little-endian bytes in%MW/%KW, mandatory terminator, max509characters, storage1..255words. FL11 permitsCR/LF/NUL terminator elseCR.
memory_model.unsupported_native_types: No documented native int64,uint64,double64,IEC TIME/DATE/DT/STRING object class,C++ pointer/reference/heap/struct types; time/date/string represented with existing words/blocks. Do not silently equate unsupported C++ types to PLC values.
